title: FinzProperty implementation inventory based on verified LankaPropertyWeb area results
scope: Read-only, official-source inventory for FinzProperty functionality analogous to LankaPropertyWeb. Only supplied verified area results are included.
excluded_scope: All Post Your Ad, post-property, ad-submission, advertiser-submission and ad-management functionality is explicitly excluded.

features.area: Property discovery: homepage, sales, rentals, land and listing details
features.name: Homepage navigation and discovery entry points
features.behavior: Homepage exposes Sales, Rentals, Land, New Development, direct property-for-sale/property-for-rent/land-for-sale/featured-projects links and Area Guide. Post-ad entry is excluded.
features.dependencies: LPW navigation and live listing/index data; featured content and counts are dynamic.

features.area: Property discovery: homepage, sales, rentals, land and listing details
features.name: Homepage search modes
features.behavior: Search modes cover near me, school, hospital and location; rendered filters include property type, land subtype, price bands, apartment type, bedrooms and possession-within. Execution was not performed.
features.dependencies: LPW search backend; near-me may require browser/device geolocation; school/hospital provider undisclosed.

features.area: Property discovery: homepage, sales, rentals, land and listing details
features.name: Sales property taxonomy
features.behavior: Sales categories include House, Apartments, Commercial Buildings, Bungalows and Villas; Commercial expands to office, shop, hotel/resort, restaurant/cafe, guest house, factory, warehouse, shopping mall, coworking, hospital, multipurpose and buildings.
features.dependencies: LPW taxonomy, live inventory and dynamic counts.

features.area: Property discovery: homepage, sales, rentals, land and listing details
features.name: Rental property taxonomy
features.behavior: Rental categories include House, Apartments, Commercial Buildings, Bungalows, Villas, Studio/Bedsit, Annexes, Hostel and Rooms; Commercial has the observed office through buildings subtypes.
features.dependencies: LPW rental taxonomy, inventory and dynamic subtype counts.

features.area: Property discovery: homepage, sales, rentals, land and listing details
features.name: Land taxonomy and offer modes
features.behavior: Land discovery includes bare, cultivated, land with house, coconut, tea, rubber, paddy/rice, beachfront, cinnamon and waterfront land, with Sale, Lease/Rent or Either.
features.dependencies: LPW land inventory and dynamic subtype/offer availability.

features.area: Property discovery: homepage, sales, rentals, land and listing details
features.name: Commercial subcategory browsing
features.behavior: Commercial sale/rental pages expose clickable subtype landing pages with result counts and SEO-style URLs.
features.dependencies: LPW category routes and live inventory counts.

features.area: Property discovery: homepage, sales, rentals, land and listing details
features.name: Location search fields and nearby modes
features.behavior: Category controls expose city/location, school/university, apartment name and hospital/clinic fields plus near-me, school, apartment, hospital and location modes; land omits apartment-name mode in extracted controls.
features.dependencies: LPW index and likely school, hospital, location and geolocation datasets; providers undisclosed.

features.area: Property discovery: homepage, sales, rentals, land and listing details
features.name: Radius filtering
features.behavior: Select Radius offers only this city or 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10 or 20 km around a selected location.
features.dependencies: Geocoded LPW listing/location data; geocoding provider undisclosed.

features.area: Property discovery: homepage, sales, rentals, land and listing details
features.name: Sales filters
features.behavior: Sales filters cover property type/subtype, total or per-square-foot price, min/max price, missing-price inclusion, bedrooms, floor area, missing-area inclusion, amenities, exact-word matching, date posted and image/availability/urgency/ready/off-plan/below-average/360/video flags.
features.dependencies: LPW filter/query backend and advertiser-supplied listing metadata.

features.area: Property discovery: homepage, sales, rentals, land and listing details
features.name: Rental filters
features.behavior: Rental filters cover location, type, bedrooms, floor area, amenities, exact-word/date controls, per-month or per-SQFT pricing, missing-price/area inclusion and image/availability/short-term/below-average/360/video flags.
features.dependencies: LPW rental query backend and advertiser-supplied rent/area/amenity data.

features.area: Property discovery: homepage, sales, rentals, land and listing details
features.name: Land filters
features.behavior: Land filters cover total/per-perch/per-acre price, missing-price inclusion, perch/acre extent, exact words, Sale/Lease/Rent/Either, date posted and image/availability/urgency/below-average/360/video flags.
features.dependencies: LPW land backend and advertiser-supplied price, extent and offer metadata.

features.area: Property discovery: homepage, sales, rentals, land and listing details
features.name: Category listing cards
features.behavior: Cards expose offer/type, locality, trend or urgency labels, bedrooms or land/floor area, subtype, prices, title, description and sometimes Verified Agent branding/detail links.
features.dependencies: LPW listing records, media, advertiser fields and LPW verification/tagging state.

features.area: Property discovery: homepage, sales, rentals, land and listing details
features.name: Pagination and result counts
features.behavior: Category pages show inventory totals, numbered pages and next links; observed commercial sale, commercial rent and land totals/pages were time-sensitive snapshots.
features.dependencies: LPW pagination/query backend and live inventory.

features.area: Property discovery: homepage, sales, rentals, land and listing details
features.name: Favorite/save property
features.behavior: Visible states include Property Saved, Favorite not saved and Favorite removed, with Manage linking to the favorite-properties dashboard; no favorite was saved.
features.dependencies: LPW account/authentication and favorite persistence; sign-in was not attempted.

features.area: Property discovery: homepage, sales, rentals, land and listing details
features.name: Save search and email alerts
features.behavior: Category pages expose Save Search and Create E-Mail Alerts; targets indicate account storage and a login gate; no alert was created.
features.dependencies: LPW account/authentication, saved-search storage and email delivery.

features.area: Property discovery: homepage, sales, rentals, land and listing details
features.name: Result-page sharing
features.behavior: Share targets are exposed for Facebook, WhatsApp, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Telegram and email with current URL/title encoded; nothing was sent.
features.dependencies: External social endpoints and user mail client.

features.area: Property discovery: homepage, sales, rentals, land and listing details
features.name: Apartment Finder view modes
features.behavior: Category pages advertise Apartment Finder Table, List and Map URLs for sales and rentals; this is not verified as a map mode for every general category.
features.dependencies: LPW Apartment Finder, map data/rendering and unknown map provider.

features.area: Property discovery: homepage, sales, rentals, land and listing details
features.name: Area/location browsing and market context
features.behavior: Area page provides national sale/rent/land price summaries, a Sri Lanka map, nearby-amenities/neighborhood headings and price selectors; Top Cities links appear on category pages. Generated national Find links resolved to Invalid City and are not treated as working navigation.
features.dependencies: LPW area/market data; map and nearby-amenity provider undisclosed.

features.area: Property discovery: homepage, sales, rentals, land and listing details
features.name: Listing detail structured information
features.behavior: Public details include breadcrumbs, photo gallery, title/locality, floor/land area, price/currency conversions, overview attributes and long property details.
features.dependencies: LPW listing record and image hosting; currency source undisclosed.

features.area: Property discovery: homepage, sales, rentals, land and listing details
features.name: Detail-page neighborhood map
features.behavior: Explore Neighbourhood includes a large-map link opening a Google Maps place URL with listing coordinates.
features.dependencies: Google Maps rendering/directions; LPW supplies coordinates.

features.area: Property discovery: homepage, sales, rentals, land and listing details
features.name: Listing detail follow-up, contact and report controls
features.behavior: Details expose advertiser identity/type, phone reveal, tel/WhatsApp, callback, contact/email/chat, email-to-friend and Report AD reasons; no action was submitted.
features.dependencies: LPW forms/backend, advertiser contacts, tel/WhatsApp and user mail client.

features.area: Property discovery: homepage, sales, rentals, land and listing details
features.name: Similar-property and neighborhood discovery
features.behavior: Details link to similar properties and constrained locality/subtype/price result sets, local property prices, Price Meter and a home-loan calculator.
features.dependencies: LPW recommendation/query backend, price data and calculators.

features.area: Property discovery: homepage, sales, rentals, land and listing details
features.name: Compare listings
features.behavior: Buying guide discusses comparing ad prices, but no explicit compare button/table/URL was observed; implement only as an unverified concept.
features.dependencies: Would require normalized LPW listing data; no verified compare endpoint.
features.confidence: Medium — documented concept, UI not verified

features.area: Property discovery: homepage, sales, rentals, land and listing details
features.name: Sorting controls/order
features.behavior: No visible Sort By control or documented ordering appeared in fetched category content; dynamic/other-route sorting cannot be ruled out.
features.dependencies: Unknown; no sorting endpoint/provider disclosed.

features.area: New developments and Apartment Finder
features.name: New-development project directory
features.behavior: Condo Directory covers new condominiums, luxury apartments, housing complexes and future developments; Show Filters, city selector, SEARCH, result count, 15-per-page and pagination are exposed.
features.dependencies: LPW project catalog, location taxonomy, pagination and dynamic inventory/counts.

features.area: New developments and Apartment Finder
features.name: Directory project cards and sale/rent pathways
features.behavior: Cards can show locality, project, address, developer, completion, floors and units, with Buy, Rent/Lease and More Details links; missing fields must be tolerated.
features.dependencies: Project metadata quality and linked sale/rental indexes.

features.area: New developments and Apartment Finder
features.name: Apartment Finder sale/rent mode
features.behavior: Finder has Sale and Rent modes; sale uses total-budget/home-loan-oriented ranges and rent uses monthly ranges, with visible mode controls.
features.dependencies: LPW apartment inventory, classification and URL query state.

features.area: New developments and Apartment Finder
features.name: Apartment Finder location, budget, bedroom and floor-area filters
features.behavior: Finder supports multi-city Add More, price inputs, 1BR–5+BR, square-foot bounds/presets and View Properties; observed sale ranges run Rs.5M–200M and rent Rs.50K–500K+.
features.dependencies: LPW location hierarchy, numeric filters and apartment attributes.

features.area: New developments and Apartment Finder
features.name: Status and market-condition filters
features.behavior: Sale toggles cover new, completed, below-market and recently sold; rent adds recently rented and short-term. Combination semantics were not verified.
features.dependencies: LPW status/completion/market-value and sold/rented flags.

features.area: New developments and Apartment Finder
features.name: Map, List and Table discovery views
features.behavior: Finder visibly offers Map, List, Table and Back to List; LPW describes Map for neighbourhoods, Table for structured scanning and List for richer browsing.
features.dependencies: Map/geocoding/rendering provider not identified, responsive state and normalized apartment data.

features.area: New developments and Apartment Finder
features.name: Project-centric aggregation and unit-level discovery
features.behavior: Finder groups units by development; cards show project/locality/price range and rows for bedroom, area, ad count, price and Sold status, with View More routing to project or grouped search.
features.dependencies: LPW project-to-listing matching, deduplication/grouping, inventory and sold/rented feeds.

features.area: New developments and Apartment Finder
features.name: Recently sold/rented recovery inquiry
features.behavior: LPW launch material says sold/rented units can lead to an inquiry connecting users with agents holding similar inventory; exact UI/routing not opened.
features.dependencies: Agent inventory matching, inquiry/lead routing and possible CAPTCHA/personal-data collection.

features.area: New developments and Apartment Finder
features.name: Project detail overview and unit matrix
features.behavior: Marina Square detail includes location, units, sizes, timing, highlights, developer, features, amenities and configurations with beds, baths, area, parking, availability, price, sea-view and SOLD OUT states.
features.dependencies: Developer/LPW project content, live unit availability/prices, media and project taxonomy.

features.area: New developments and Apartment Finder
features.name: Neighbourhood and nearby-place discovery
features.behavior: Project page offers neighbourhood categories (banks, cinemas, restaurants, groceries, hospitals, shopping, parks, bus stands, gas, police and schools) plus nearest-place references/distances.
features.dependencies: Geocoding/map provider and nearby-place data; some facts manually curated.

features.area: New developments and Apartment Finder
features.name: Brochure/availability affordances
features.behavior: Visible brochure-labelled controls, Check Availability, unit-level and callback actions exist, but no concrete brochure URL/download was verified.
features.dependencies: Brochure storage, availability endpoint, project content and possible gated lead form.

features.area: New developments and Apartment Finder
features.name: Project-page home-loan repayment calculator
features.behavior: Project loan module supports LKR/USD, property value, down payment, rate and period and outputs EMI, loan amount, interest and total payment; apply action exists.
features.dependencies: EMI logic, user inputs, rates/currency and bank/advisor lead service.

features.area: New developments and Apartment Finder
features.name: Repayment-oriented Apartment Finder search
features.behavior: Sale price section offers Total budget, Monthly payment and With a Home Loan modes; exact repayment inputs, assumptions and math were not verified.
features.dependencies: Loan/repayment calculation, rate/tenure assumptions, affordability query and apartment data.
features.confidence: Medium-high — documented labels, math not verified

features.area: New developments and Apartment Finder
features.name: Cross-bank loan comparison, repayment plan and borrowing power
features.behavior: Loan page compares 15+ banks with lowest-rate/lowest-installment sorting, EMI/yearly plan and borrowing-power inputs for income, co-applicant and commitments.
features.dependencies: Bank rate/product data, EMI and affordability rules, lender/advisor service.

features.area: New developments and Apartment Finder
features.name: Enquiry and contact pathways on project pages
features.behavior: Project page exposes phone/WhatsApp, availability, email, inquiry, callback and chat/call plus name/email/contact form, optional marketing checkbox and reCAPTCHA; no submission.
features.dependencies: Agent/developer contacts, tel/wa.me, email/lead routing, chat, reCAPTCHA and user data.

features.area: New developments and Apartment Finder
features.name: Market and unit price comparison support
features.behavior: Buying guide recommends price comparisons, House Price Index, Area Guides and ROI; grouped unit rows/Table view assist scanning, not a side-by-side workspace.
features.dependencies: Listing/price history, indexes, area data and ROI logic.

features.area: New developments and Apartment Finder
features.name: Dedicated side-by-side unit comparison control
features.behavior: No explicit compare checkbox, shortlist or side-by-side unit workspace was found in extracted Finder/directory/project content; do not infer it.
features.dependencies: If implemented by FinzProperty, normalized unit attributes, selection state and persistence would be needed.

features.area: Agents, assistance and professional services

features.area: Agents, assistance and professional services

features.area: Agents, assistance and professional services

features.area: Agents, assistance and professional services

features.area: Agents, assistance and professional services

features.area: Calculators, valuation, market data and insights
features.name: Home Loan Calculator (EMI)
features.behavior: Inputs currency, property value, down payment, rate and period; outputs EMI, loan amount, rate, total interest and total payable.
features.dependencies: User inputs and LPW stated fixed-rate assumption; final rates depend on bank assessment.

features.area: Calculators, valuation, market data and insights
features.name: Property-linked Home Loan Calculator
features.behavior: Property detail links to calculator with advertised property value passed in URL; destination state was not opened.
features.dependencies: Listing price and standalone LPW calculator; advertised price is not transaction price.

features.area: Calculators, valuation, market data and insights
features.name: ROI Calculator
features.behavior: Accepts Sri Lankan area, price, loan/down payment/rate/term, income, expenses and sale assumptions; outputs holding-period and annualized ROI, real return, instalment and loan cost.
features.dependencies: User assumptions; no live external feed disclosed.

features.area: Calculators, valuation, market data and insights
features.name: Online Property Price Indicator / Price Meter
features.behavior: Choose Sale/Rental/Land and property type; Check now leads to indicative price flow not submitted. LPW describes OPPI as an ad-based statistical model, not a registered valuation.
features.dependencies: LPW advertised-property dataset/model and user selections.

features.area: Calculators, valuation, market data and insights
features.name: Certified Valuation Referral
features.behavior: Price Meter/Market Insights offer Request a Quote for certified valuer inspection and formal report; not requested.
features.dependencies: External certified/registered valuer and LPW assistance workflow.

features.area: Calculators, valuation, market data and insights
features.name: Property-page Currency Converter
features.behavior: Detail page displays LKR plus USD, GBP, EUR, JPY, INR, AUD, CAD, CNY and RUB values; selector/source/timing unverified.
features.dependencies: LPW FX data/service and listing LKR price.

features.area: Calculators, valuation, market data and insights
features.name: Home Loan Comparison Rate Board
features.behavior: Compares 15 banks; accepts loan amount, period and contribution, recalculates and sorts by rate or instalment; rates/terms are advertised estimates.
features.dependencies: LPW-maintained bank rates/product terms; final rates, fees and approval depend on bank.

features.area: Calculators, valuation, market data and insights
features.name: Home Loan Repayment Plan
features.behavior: Calculator accepts property value, down payment, rate and period and shows EMI, totals and year-by-year principal/interest/balance.
features.dependencies: User inputs, advertised rate and LPW amortization logic.

features.area: Calculators, valuation, market data and insights
features.name: Borrowing Power / Housing Affordability Calculator
features.behavior: Inputs monthly income, co-applicant income and commitments; LPW documents a typical 40% free-income repayment rule and 60% total-deduction guidance.
features.dependencies: Inputs and heuristic; lender policy, age, loans, expenses and verification determine actual ceiling.

features.area: Calculators, valuation, market data and insights
features.name: House Price Index / Average Property Prices
features.behavior: Quarter snapshots Q4 2011–Q2 2026 report asking sale averages for houses/apartments/commercial buildings by region, with YoY change and methodology caveats.
features.dependencies: About 15,000 LPW ads; asking prices, outlier/algorithm updates and insufficient-data handling.

features.area: Calculators, valuation, market data and insights
features.name: Public Rental Price Data
features.behavior: Official data reports average monthly asking rents for standard 4-bedroom houses and 3-bedroom apartments across Sri Lankan regions.
features.dependencies: LPW ad sample/methodology; asking rents, coverage varies.

features.area: Calculators, valuation, market data and insights
features.name: Gross Rental Yield and Rental Analysis
features.behavior: MOR26/MOR25 document average rents, YoY changes, regional comparisons and gross-yield analysis; detailed figures are gated/not all public.
features.dependencies: LPW research, asking-price/rent/search data and macro inputs; full report requires registration/contact.

features.area: Calculators, valuation, market data and insights
features.name: Land Price Index
features.behavior: 2017-base index reports average residential land price per perch by district/city, YoY change, change since 2017 and insufficient-data labels.
features.dependencies: Advertised land-for-sale data from multiple sites; asking values and local differences matter.

features.area: Calculators, valuation, market data and insights
features.name: Market Insights Dashboard
features.behavior: Hub links reports, HPI, Land Index, OPPI, ROI and loan tools; displays headline/rate cards and Total Sales period selector.
features.dependencies: LPW listing/research data, bank rates and linked tool freshness.

features.area: Calculators, valuation, market data and insights

features.behavior: MOR26/MOR25 scope includes macro indicators, supply gap, incomes, construction, rates, prices/demand, management fees, rents/yields, land, traffic, commercial leases and tourism; summaries public, full/limited access gated.
features.dependencies: LPW research plus external macro/banking/construction/demographic/tourism inputs and access tier.

features.area: Calculators, valuation, market data and insights

features.behavior: Search-index evidence describes Sale Price, Percent Down, Term, Interest Rate and Calculate, but direct extraction failed; not an LPW-verified feature.
